title: The Night Before
subtitle: The island invites no one, with the exception of children.

items.text: After the Good Dream
The Night Before

Do not love half lovers
                              Do not entertain half friends
                              Do not indulge in works of the half talented
                              Do not live half a life and do not die a half death

                                               — Kahlil Gibran, "Half is not Enough"

items.speaker: The "Great" Storyteller
items.text: You've certainly heard your fair share of stories. From the bedtime tales your mom told you to the bragging from kids at school...

items.speaker: The "Great" Storyteller
items.text: Or, or... like those smooth talkers you occasionally encounter in taverns.

items.speaker: The "Great" Storyteller
items.text: Stories in the classroom, on benches where pigeons are fed, on TV and in comic books... you've heard plenty, and most of them are cliché.

items.speaker: The "Great" Storyteller
items.text: But hear me out, I’m sure you’ve never heard a story as astonishing and legendary as this one!

items.speaker: The "Great" Storyteller
items.text: It's more thrilling than the surging waves of the sea—a story that a bard could captivate a tavern full of drunks with, every one of them forgetting their drinks.

items.speaker: The "Great" Storyteller
items.text: And you. You will be honored as its very first listener!
The room is silent, the chaos outside blocked by the suitcase. Not even a thousand woodpeckers could peck open this door—
"Bang—!"
The door bursts open.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, now's the time, put the arm ring on her!
Sonetto pins the girl to the ground and winds back her head, preparing to deliver a dizzying headbutt.
You bunch of sneak-attacking thieves! Harald will come looking, and then he'll throw you all... into the sea to feed the fish!
What—what are you doing!?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Erick, we need you to calm down.
The arm ring settles in its familiar resting place, grasping her slender yet firm arm.
They bind her with rope and place her in a chair.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Let—me go!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: You damn kidnappers, eat my foot!
The girl's feet, unable to touch the ground, jab wildly at her two captors.
But like a puppy on a leash, her target is just out of reach.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Sorry, it was my miscalculation... I thought a 12-year-old Arcanist would be gentler and more... controllable.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No one could have anticipated this.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Yes. Next time, I'll consider using Arcane Skills.

items.speaker: The "Great" Storyteller
items.text: At this moment, our protagonist, a brave and clever captive, watches quietly. She narrows her eyes, trying to determine the origin of her two assailants.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Huh? Ah, I've seen that emblem before. So you're from that What's-it-called Foundation!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You know about us!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Hmph, of course. I have eyes and ears everywhere.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Anyway, neither of you will pry a word out of me! Even if you pull out my teeth one by one without any anesthetic, it's impossible!
Erick proudly raises her head, as if her hands are akimbo on her hips rather than bound behind her back.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I've seen your family’s records. Your mother's side has lived in Sogn Fjord for generations.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: She’s an extraordinary woman. The Norwegian branch of the St. Pavlov Foundation has received a lot of help from her.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But ever since she...

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Quite well-informed, aren't you, long-ears?

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: If she hadn't sailed off for that incredible treasure, you would never have caught me!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto...
Vertin gives a subtle shake of the head.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ...I understand.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Anyway, you're living with your grandfather and father now, right?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We mean you no harm. Just, considering your father’s and grandfather's status as Arcanists, we would like to offer you as much help as possible.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We have a unique school filled with kids like you—extraordinary ones. I think you'd be interested.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: But I'm already in school—I mean, I already have a school within my territory!

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: I have a crew of sailors there, ready to plunder everything here at my signal!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But our school is unique. It's full of territories yet unclaimed.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Yes, and a bunch of kids—sailors—yearning for a jarl to lead them.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Oh... that does sound tempting. More interesting than the tedium of Stillwater Lake School anyway...

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: But I need to speak to my crew. Not for their approval, of course! Just so they don't panic without me.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: You know, they're lost without someone at the helm—

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We've already gotten Harald's consent, Erick.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: But...
A small wooden scabbard lies on the table, along with a letter.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is what he left for you.
Erick, her hands freed, picks up the letter from the table.

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “Erick, you're about to venture into a place full of dangers. It will be daunting and fearsome.”

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “Every warrior of Valhalla must face such a challenge before adulthood; you will endure many hardships and a long, long time without us.”

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “But I believe you'll make new friendships and return triumphant with countless treasures.”

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “When the time comes, your father and I will throw a night-long feast for you, with unlimited soda and popcorn of every flavor.”

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “Note: You can trust these two; they're good people.”

items.speaker: Letter
items.text: “––Yours forever, Harald.”

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Oh… okay, I thought I'd get a proper chance to say goodbye to everyone.

items.speaker: Erick
items.text: Jason “the Slob's” workbook is still at my place, and there are two raid allowances I haven’t used this month...
She sulks, cupping her cheeks, elbows on the table, her face puffed up like a blowfish.
TO BE CONTINUED…
